messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

Each unit is the title of a song by the Beatles. Which one was first released on the album Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band?

Units:
- I'm Happy Just to Dance with You
- Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da
- Being for the Benefit of Mr. Kite!
- Got to Get You into My Life
- Hey Bulldog
- Kansas City/Hey-Hey-Hey-Hey!
- Yesterday
- I Want You (She's So Heavy)
